design.scope: only frozen 2/3-peer toys; no full real cohort inference, labels, CV, fit or candidate
design.actual_cases: smallest/largest source cohort by(peer_count,month,target_id), target plus smallest-ID1/2 others; omitted peers fixed at their prior means
synthetic_cases: two competing copy assignments with singular aggregate and nonzero orthogonal residual
design.representation: whiten .6*remainder covariance; exact peer and aggregate affine SVD spans; rank0 deterministic; no covariance floors
design.prior_sites: Gaussian natural parameters, removed before exact finite-support tilt; coupled components never separated
design.likelihood: unchanged df5 Student t; Gamma(2.5,rate2.5) mixture; preserve orthogonal residual evidence
design.initializer: Gaussian moments of original support weights times exp(0/-2/+2 times standardized original y); exact model prior stays original
design.update: aggregate site first, then each peer in frozen order; fixed natural-parameter damping; no backtracking
design.quadrature_audit: each case/view original-prior aggregate cavity; fixed quad_vec reference epsabs1e-11/epsrel1e-11/limit200, both32/64nodes must pass
design.decision: reject this fixed approximation if any run is invalid/unconverged or any evidence threshold fails; no repair, tuning or budget extension
design.interpretation: numerical evidence thresholds do not prove every biased approximation scientifically useless
